maddeler.e:
ينهمر (form VII)
# يَنْهَمِرُ (yanhamiru) /jan.ha.mi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# يَنْهَمِرَ (yanhamira) /jan.ha.mi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# يَنْهَمِرْ (yanhamir) /jan.ha.mir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
